text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, September 6, 2018 Posted by admin on September 6th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +35 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +22.51 (+0.09%) at 25,974.99.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +4.99%.
There were 19 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) +1.70% and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) +1.60%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Visa (V) -3.47% and Microsoft (MSFT) -2.88%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is up 1.1 cents at $2.854 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
